documents.text:
Vendor due diligence summary: Kalvik Energy (fictional, authored test material).
Pension deficit at Kalvik Energy stood at €72.8m in FY2025 (reported basis). Kalvik Energy had cost synergies of EUR 58.1 million in FY2024 (reported basis). For Kalvik Energy, run-rate EBITDA in H1 2025 was €37.5m (reported basis). Capex as share of sales at Kalvik Energy stood at 10% in FY2023.

documents.title: Management presentation
documents.text:
Management presentation: Kalvik Energy (fictional, authored test material).
Net revenue retention at Kalvik Energy stood at 122.165% in FY2024. Kalvik Energy had pension deficit of EUR 72800 thousand in FY2025 (reported basis). For Kalvik Energy, cost synergies in FY2024 was €58.1m (reported basis). Order backlog at Kalvik Energy stood at €327.1m in FY2025 (reported basis), as originally reported. The scope of the tax warranty for Kalvik Energy is understood as follows: covers periods up to completion and the following tax year.
